name: goose
writeNote: tk has no YAML writer; paste the fragment or use `goose configure`. goose itself rewrites the whole file with serde_yaml, so comments go when goose writes
nameMangling: name_to_key keeps [A-Za-z0-9_-], drops whitespace, turns the rest into _, lowercases; no length cap (V, crates/goose/src/config/extensions.rs#L22-L31)
notes: Stdio: type stdio, name, cmd, args, envs, env_keys, timeout; HTTP: type streamable_http, uri (not url), headers. No SSE variant in v1.56.0; an entry that fails to parse is skipped with an info log (V). $VAR and ${VAR} substitute only from the entry's envs and env_keys, and only in uri, header values, socket, client_id and cwd, never in cmd or args (V, extension.rs#L382-L519). goose drops LD_PRELOAD, NODE_OPTIONS, PYTHONPATH and similar env keys (V). The user folder is $GOOSE_PATH_ROOT/config, else the XDG strategy (~/.config/goose) on macOS too (I, strong: etcetera 0.11.0). GOOSE_ADDITIONAL_CONFIG_FILES are read-only layers.
sources: github.com/block/goose at v1.56.0: crates/goose/src/config/base.rs, config/paths.rs, config/extensions.rs, agents/extension.rs, mcp_client.rs; lunacookies/etcetera v0.11.0 src/app_strategy.rs (lane C research, 27 Oct 2026)

coverage.note: Auto mode, the default, asks nothing; tk run sets GOOSE_MODE=approve when the policy has asks
